dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you have something against the Fatui?

dialogues.speaker: Avreliya
dialogues.text: Not at all. As fellow servants of Her Majesty, we should work together as one. And now with a crisis looming in the horizon, this is no time to dwell on old grievances.

dialogues.speaker: Avreliya
dialogues.text: Whether our Fatui colleagues understand that, however, is not for me to decide. As you can see, all I can do is govern myself, and remain ever loyal to Her Majesty.
